title: MAREA
tagline: An immersive fragrance event set inside a frozen wave. Guests cross a dark reef-rock threshold, walk on sand and crushed shell, and meet each fragrance in a sphere of water.
description:
Guests approach through a dark reef-rock threshold, step onto sand mixed with crushed shell and pass under a translucent wave that curls over the whole hall. The wave is the anchor of the space and the photo zone.

The product stays the focus: each fragrance sits in a sphere of rippling water above a pedestal of water-worn stone, held by corals.

The evening is a sequence of light. With each new fragrance the water changes colour, from turquoise to violet to warm amber.

Independent concept. Unbuilt.
meta_description: MAREA is an immersive fragrance event concept: a translucent wave over the hall, fragrances in spheres of water on stone pedestals, and light that changes colour with each scent.

lead.caption: Hall. A translucent wave curls over the space; each fragrance stands in a sphere of water on a stone pedestal, with tall tubes of small fish at the edges.

images.caption: Approach. A dark reef-rock threshold with a lit arch ahead.
Entrance. The arch opens onto sand and crushed shell, with the wave glowing beyond.
Fragrance. A sphere of rippling water above a pedestal of water-worn stone, held by corals.
Photo zone. The wave overhead becomes the backdrop for guests.
View to the entrance. Pedestals line the way back to the arch.
Turquoise. The first colour of the evening.
Violet. The water changes colour as the next fragrance arrives.
Amber. The last colour in the sequence, warm light across the sand.
